changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwdiagnostictest AS SELECT dt.id, dt.type, dt.name, dt.internal_code, dt.age_specific, dt.age_group, dt.gender_specific, dt.gender, dt.special_population, dt.special_population_values, dt.price, dt.currency, dt.special_notes, dt.is_active, dt.appointable, dt.parallel_capacity_value, dt.default_duration_minutes, dt.default_buffer_before_minutes, dt.default_buffer_after_minutes, dt.created_date, dt.created_by, dt.last_modified_by, dt.last_modified_date, dt.modality, dt.short_name, dt.billing_rule_id, dt.hl7_integration_code FROM public.diagnostic_test dt;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwdiagnostictest TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwdiagnostictest FROM report_user;
